topic: How would the 0.25 dB passband loss affect link budget margins in low-noise satellite receiver frontends?
consensus_response: A 0.25 dB passband loss in low-noise satellite receiver frontends reduces the signal-to-noise ratio, impacting link budget margins through increased noise figure and non-linear effects, such as phase noise and compression point degradation, ultimately affecting system reliability and performance.
reference_context: Satellite communication systems rely on link budget margins to ensure reliable transmission, with parameters like noise temperature and antenna gains impacting performance.
